verdict.rationale: RingCentral's developer portal points users to official MCP servers ('Try our MCP servers', 'See MCP servers'), and its homepage says customers can connect RingCentral to LLMs like ChatGPT and Claude, so a first-party MCP offering exists. The evidence is only link-level marketing text, with no detail on which tools are exposed, how to set it up, or how authentication works. Missing for 10: MCP server documentation (tool list, setup, transport/hosting), auth/scope details for agent connections, independent or hands-on corroboration.
